theme.en: Chipmakers Lock In the Next AI Cycle
theme.zh: 芯片厂商锁定下一轮AI周期

dek.en: TSMC advances A16 while Nvidia reportedly secures memory and Qualcomm circles a $4 billion AI-software acquisition. Across the stack, process readiness, supply access, and engineering talent are being locked down before the next expansion phase.
dek.zh: TSMC推进A16，Nvidia据报锁定长期存储供应，Qualcomm则接近一笔价值$4B的AI软件收购。从制程、供应到工程人才，产业链正在下一轮扩张前抢先锁定关键资源。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Amazon's Custom-Chip Business Reaches a $25 Billion Run Rate
title.zh: Amazon定制芯片业务运行规模达到$25B

summary.en: Amazon's custom-chip business has crossed a reported $25 billion run rate, putting a concrete figure on the cloud provider's silicon push. The scale suggests that in-house accelerators and infrastructure processors are becoming a material business, not merely a way to reduce dependence on merchant chips.
summary.zh: 据报道，Amazon定制芯片业务的运行规模已超过$25B，为这家云服务商的自研芯片投入提供了具体量级。该规模表明，自研加速器和基础设施处理器正成为一项实质性业务，而不只是降低对通用商用芯片依赖的手段。

title.en: AMD Upstreams RDNA 4m Firmware Ahead of New APUs
title.zh: AMD在新一代APU发布前上游提交RDNA 4m固件

summary.en: AMD has published GFX 11.7-based RDNA 4m firmware to the linux-firmware repository ahead of the associated products' launch. Upstream availability lets Linux distributions package the binaries with AMDGPU support and is a practical sign that the next APU platform is moving closer to release.
summary.zh: AMD已在相关产品发布前，将基于GFX 11.7的RDNA 4m固件提交至linux-firmware仓库。上游固件到位后，Linux发行版可将其与AMDGPU驱动一同打包，也是下一代APU平台接近发布的实际信号。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC Completes Its 1.6nm-Class A16 Process Ahead of Q4
title.zh: TSMC在第四季度前完成1.6nm级A16制程

summary.en: TSMC has reportedly completed development of its 1.6nm-class A16 process ahead of the fourth quarter. The milestone keeps pressure on Samsung at the leading edge, although the supplied report does not provide yield, customer tape-out, or volume-ramp data needed to judge manufacturing readiness.
summary.zh: 据报道，TSMC已在第四季度前完成1.6nm级A16制程开发。这一里程碑继续给Samsung的先进制程施压，但现有报道未提供良率、客户流片或量产爬坡数据，因此尚不足以判断实际制造成熟度。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Nvidia Reportedly Signs a Multi-Year Memory Deal With Micron
title.zh: Nvidia据报与Micron签署多年存储供应协议

summary.en: Nvidia may have signed a multi-year memory agreement with Micron, according to a report from XenoSpectrum. If confirmed, the deal would give Nvidia longer supply visibility and give Micron a firmer demand anchor, but the candidate record provides no volume, product mix, or contract value.
summary.zh: XenoSpectrum报道称，Nvidia可能已与Micron签署多年存储供应协议。若消息属实，该协议将提升Nvidia的长期供应可见度，也为Micron提供更稳固的需求锚点；但候选记录未披露采购量、产品组合或合同金额。

title.en: Micron Plans Its First U.S. Memory Laboratory
title.zh: Micron计划建设首个美国存储实验室

summary.en: Micron plans to build its first U.S. memory laboratory as it competes with Samsung and SK hynix, according to Seoul Economic Daily. A domestic lab would expand Micron's research footprint near its U.S. manufacturing ambitions, though the candidate record does not specify location, budget, or opening date.
summary.zh: 据《首尔经济日报》报道，Micron计划建设其首个美国存储实验室，以应对Samsung和SK hynix的竞争。美国本土实验室将扩大Micron在其制造布局附近的研发能力，但候选记录未说明选址、预算或启用时间。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: LG PRI Wins Its First Production-Line Order for a Packaging LDI Tool
title.zh: LG PRI获得首笔封装LDI设备量产线订单

summary.en: LG PRI has reportedly secured its first production-line order for a laser direct imaging tool used in semiconductor packaging. Moving from evaluation to a line order is the important signal for a new equipment supplier, although the candidate record does not identify the customer, tool count, or deployment schedule.
summary.zh: 据报道，LG PRI已获得首笔用于半导体封装的激光直接成像（LDI）设备量产线订单。对新设备供应商而言，从评估阶段进入产线订单是关键信号，但候选记录未披露客户、设备数量或部署进度。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Washington May Let Apple Buy Memory From CXMT and YMTC
title.zh: 美国据报可能允许Apple采购CXMT与YMTC存储芯片

summary.en: The Trump administration may allow Apple to procure DRAM from CXMT and NAND from YMTC after Xi Jinping's planned September U.S. visit, according to Wccftech. Such an exception would turn memory sourcing into a bargaining lever in U.S.-China talks and could ease Apple's supply constraints, but the report describes a prospective policy outcome rather than a completed approval.
summary.zh: Wccftech报道称，特朗普政府可能在习近平计划于9月访美后，允许Apple采购CXMT的DRAM和YMTC的NAND。若获批，存储采购将成为中美谈判的一项筹码，并可能缓解Apple的供应约束；但该报道描述的是潜在政策结果，而非已经完成的批准。

title.en: Chinese AI and Chip Companies Turn to Equity to Retain Engineers
title.zh: 中国AI与芯片企业以股权留住工程师

summary.en: Chinese AI and semiconductor companies are distributing equity to retain engineers, The Next Web reports. The practice shows that talent retention has become another constraint on domestic technology expansion, alongside access to advanced chips and manufacturing equipment.
summary.zh: The Next Web报道称，中国AI和半导体企业正通过发放股权留住工程师。这表明除先进芯片和制造设备之外，人才留存也已成为国内技术扩张的一项约束。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 财报与市场

title.en: Samsung Sets Out a Shareholder-Return Plan Worth Up to $80 Billion
title.zh: Samsung公布最高$80B股东回报计划

summary.en: Samsung has announced a shareholder-return plan worth as much as $80 billion following SK hynix's buyback, according to the supplied report. The scale raises the capital-allocation stakes between Korea's two largest memory suppliers as both also need to fund the AI-memory race.
summary.zh: 据候选报道，Samsung在SK hynix实施回购后公布了一项最高达$80B的股东回报计划。两家韩国大型存储供应商仍需为AI存储竞争投入资金，这一计划也进一步提高了双方资本配置的压力。

title.en: Desktop CPU Shipments Fall 20% as AMD Reaches Record Share
title.zh: 桌面CPU出货量下滑20%，AMD份额创纪录

summary.en: Desktop CPU shipments fell 20% amid elevated component costs, yet AMD captured record share while Intel pushed millions of processors into the notebook market. The split shows a contracting desktop category can still produce major share shifts, with Intel's volume strength in laptops not stopping AMD's broader gains.
summary.zh: 在零部件成本高企的背景下，桌面CPU出货量下降20%，但AMD仍创下份额纪录，Intel则向笔记本市场投放了数百万颗处理器。这说明即使桌面市场收缩，竞争格局仍会显著变化；Intel在笔记本领域的出货优势也未能阻止AMD扩大整体份额。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: Qualcomm Reportedly Nears a $4 Billion Deal for Modular
title.zh: Qualcomm据报接近以$4B收购Modular

summary.en: Qualcomm is reportedly in advanced talks to acquire AI startup Modular for $4 billion. If completed, the transaction would signal consolidation around AI compute software and give Qualcomm a larger platform asset, but the candidate record describes negotiations rather than a signed deal.
summary.zh: 据报道，Qualcomm正就以$4B收购AI初创公司Modular进行深入谈判。若交易完成，将表明AI计算软件领域开始整合，并为Qualcomm增加一项平台型资产；但候选记录描述的仍是谈判，而非已签署协议。

theme.en: Verification and Scheduling Move Up the Stack
theme.zh: 验证与调度持续向栈上层延伸

dek.en: This week's systems papers push verification, placement, tracing, and service-level scheduling into more integrated tool flows. Device work on ScAlN and GaN provides a measured counterpoint at the physical layer.
dek.zh: 本周系统论文将验证、布局、追踪和服务等级调度纳入更集成的工具流程。ScAlN与GaN器件研究则以实测结果补足物理层视角。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Sc-Composition Sequencing Controls the Structural Stability of Sputter-Epitaxial ScAlN/GaN Multilayers
title.zh: Sc组分排序控制溅射外延ScAlN/GaN多层结构稳定性

papers.authors: N. Mimasaka, K. Ikeda, M. Naito, et al.

summary.en: ScAlN multilayers grown on GaN/6H-SiC remained coherently strained in-plane whether Sc content stepped down toward about 6% or up toward about 22%. The increasing-Sc sequence produced more roughness, needle-like features, and c-axis deviation, while decreasing Sc was structurally more stable. The result is measured by high-resolution X-ray diffraction and reciprocal-space mapping, but it covers short four-step growth sequences under one sputtering condition rather than a manufacturing window.
summary.zh: 在GaN/6H-SiC上生长的ScAlN多层结构，无论Sc含量逐步降至约6%还是升至约22%，均保持面内相干应变。Sc递增序列出现更明显的粗糙度、针状表面特征和c轴偏离，而Sc递减序列结构更稳定。结果来自高分辨率X射线衍射和倒易空间映射实测，但仅覆盖单一溅射条件下的四段短时生长，尚不能代表完整制造窗口。

title.en: GaN HEMTs Remove Reverse-Recovery Spikes in a 130 kHz WPT Inverter
title.zh: GaN HEMT消除130 kHz无线供电逆变器的反向恢复尖峰

papers.authors: M. Bogdanović, Ž. Despotović, D. Marčetić, et al.

summary.en: A measured 130 kHz L-S-tuned GaN full-bridge inverter commutates through third-quadrant conduction during dead time and eliminates the reverse-recovery current spikes seen with Si IGBTs. The comparison isolates GaN's zero-reverse-recovery behavior from system-level variables, making dead-time tuning the central trade-off between shoot-through risk and conduction loss. The evidence is hardware-based, but it comes from one inverter topology and operating regime.
summary.zh: 一套实测的130 kHz L-S调谐GaN全桥逆变器在死区期间通过第三象限导通完成换流，消除了Si IGBT方案中的反向恢复电流尖峰。该比较将GaN零反向恢复特性与系统级变量分离，使死区调节成为直通风险与导通损耗之间的核心权衡。证据来自真实硬件，但目前仅覆盖一种逆变器拓扑和工作区间。

title.en: Circuits, Architecture & Reliability
title.zh: 电路、架构与可靠性

title.en: Performance Verification Across Four Generations of AmpereOne
title.zh: 跨四代AmpereOne核心的性能验证方法

papers.authors: D. Al-Otoom, N. Kelly, A. Lindsay, et al.

summary.en: Ampere describes a pre-silicon verification flow used across four generations of AmpereOne, correlating cycle-accurate RTL against a trace-driven performance model. Daily regressions, curated workloads, and a unified event stream let teams isolate units such as branch prediction and L2 prefetch before full-core correlation. The paper is valuable as an industrial methodology report, though the supplied abstract gives no quantitative defect-escape or schedule comparison against alternative flows.
summary.zh: Ampere介绍了一套用于四代AmpereOne的流片前性能验证流程，通过周期精确的RTL与轨迹驱动性能模型进行关联。每日回归、精选工作负载和统一事件流，使团队可先隔离分支预测与L2预取等单元，再进行整核关联。该文的价值主要在工业方法论，但现有摘要未给出相对其他流程的缺陷漏检率或进度改善数据。

title.en: An Open RISC-V Trace Encoder With N-Trace and E-Trace Back Ends
title.zh: 支持N-Trace与E-Trace后端的开放RISC-V追踪编码器

summary.en: CTTE provides a synthesizable SystemVerilog trace encoder with one protocol-agnostic front end and selectable RISC-V N-Trace/Nexus or E-Trace back ends. It has been integrated with six cores from five suppliers and tested on 64-bit Linux systems, including two-hart SMP; source-side process filtering doubled observation depth in a fixed buffer. The open implementation fills a practical tooling gap, although the result remains a preprint rather than a standardized reference implementation.
summary.zh: CTTE提供一套可综合的SystemVerilog追踪编码器，以统一的协议无关前端连接可选的RISC-V N-Trace/Nexus或E-Trace后端。该实现已集成到5家供应商的6款核心，并在包括双hart SMP在内的64位Linux系统上测试；源端进程过滤使固定缓冲区中的观察深度翻倍。它填补了开放工具链中的实际空白，但目前仍是预印本，并非标准参考实现。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: ODEONN: A Digital ODE Solver for Oscillatory Neural Networks
title.zh: ODEONN：面向振荡神经网络的数字ODE求解架构

summary.en: ODEONN is a modular fully digital architecture for oscillatory neural networks that supports complex-valued coupling rather than a single fixed application. Its sine approximation uses half the hardware resources of standard methods, with less than 2% degradation versus full-precision software, and the reported energy-delay product is 45× lower than conventional software execution. The comparison is against software rather than taped-out silicon, so implementation efficiency still needs physical validation.
summary.zh: ODEONN是一种模块化的全数字振荡神经网络架构，支持复数耦合，而非仅面向单一固定应用。其正弦近似相较标准方法节省一半硬件资源，相对全精度软件的性能下降低于2%，报告的能量延迟积则比传统软件执行低45倍。当前对比对象是软件而非流片芯片，因此实现效率仍需物理验证。

title.en: APEX Exploits Dual Sparsity for Precise SNN Inference
title.zh: APEX利用双重稀疏性实现精确SNN推理

papers.authors: D. B. Venkatesh, S. Radhakrishnan, R. Rakshit, et al.

summary.en: APEX maps the PASC-IF neuron into the LoAS accelerator framework to preserve ANN-equivalent accuracy at fewer spiking-inference timesteps. A three-stage PASC-IF datapath is implemented as combinational logic without added latency, while the architecture exploits sparsity in two dimensions. The supplied abstract is truncated before quantitative efficiency results, and the preprint does not establish measured-silicon performance.
summary.zh: APEX将PASC-IF神经元映射到LoAS加速器框架中，以更少的脉冲推理时间步保持与ANN等效的精度。三级PASC-IF数据通路采用组合逻辑实现，不增加额外延迟，同时架构利用两个维度的稀疏性。候选摘要在定量能效结果前被截断，且预印本尚未证明实测芯片性能。

title.en: AI Research for Hardware
title.zh: 面向硬件的AI研究

title.en: Multi-Tier SLA Scheduling for LLM Serving
title.zh: 面向LLM服务的多层SLA调度

papers.authors: A. Vestrum, A. Raeesi, H. Roed

summary.en: This work extends Llumnix from two priority levels to an arbitrary number of service tiers using per-tier headroom, tier-aware dispatch, and migration. Evaluation covers uniform, Gaussian, and enterprise-style priority mixes in the Vidur simulator against INFaaS, vLLM, Orca, and Sarathi-Serve baselines. The design better matches production SLA hierarchies, but all evidence in the supplied record is simulation-based rather than from a live inference cluster.
summary.zh: 该研究将Llumnix从两个优先级扩展为任意数量的服务层级，引入分层余量、层级感知调度与迁移机制。评估在Vidur模拟器中覆盖均匀、高斯和企业型优先级分布，并与INFaaS、vLLM、Orca及Sarathi-Serve比较。该设计更贴近生产环境的SLA层级，但候选记录中的证据全部来自模拟，而非真实推理集群。

title.en: EDA & Verification
title.zh: EDA与验证

title.en: Congestion-Aware NoC Placement and Routing for FPGAs
title.zh: 面向FPGA的拥塞感知NoC布局与路由

summary.en: The authors add NoC link-congestion cost and turn-model packet routing directly to VPR's placement flow for NoC-equipped FPGAs. Jointly considering programmable routing and packet-path diversity lets the placer reject oversubscribed network choices earlier, with evaluation across 29 benchmarks. The candidate abstract is truncated before the full numerical result, and the work remains an open-flow preprint rather than a production-tool study.
summary.zh: 作者将NoC链路拥塞成本和转向模型分组路由直接加入面向NoC FPGA的VPR布局流程。通过联合考虑可编程布线与数据包路径多样性，布局器可更早排除链路过度订阅的选择，并在29个基准上进行评估。候选摘要在完整数值结果前被截断，且该工作仍是开放流程预印本，并非生产级工具研究。

title.en: GoalEvolve Optimizes Physical-Design Algorithms Against Final QoR
title.zh: GoalEvolve以最终QoR驱动物理设计算法优化

papers.authors: H. Liu, L. Zhou, Y. Ren, et al.

summary.en: GoalEvolve evolves physical-design algorithms against end-to-end quality-of-results targets instead of optimizing each stage in isolation. It identifies the dominant target gap, traces it to a flow stage, and uses full-flow evaluation to retain only changes that survive downstream effects; across eight ASAP7 designs, post-route total negative slack improved by 30.67% on average. The gains come from benchmark designs in a research flow, so transfer to commercial nodes and production constraints remains unproven.
summary.zh: GoalEvolve以端到端QoR目标演化物理设计算法，而不是孤立优化各个阶段。它识别最主要的目标缺口，将其定位到具体流程阶段，并通过全流程评估只保留下游仍有效的改动；在8个ASAP7设计上，布线后总负裕量平均改善30.67%。这些增益来自研究流程中的基准设计，能否迁移到商用制程和生产约束仍待验证。
